title: Contrix Member Identity
description: Realm-scoped, actor-scoped full member_identity segment. It is carried by cx.member.identity.update in plaintext or inside encrypted-envelope.schema.json. Replacement events that name segment=member_identity MUST carry this complete object. This object discloses subject_id and display_profile for Realm UI projection; handle lifecycle is intentionally excluded and is governed only by cx.schema.handle_claim.v1 issuer claims. Mention / reply / quote / actor attribution MUST use subject_id (the principal DID), never a handle string.

actor_id.description: Effective member actor DID in this Realm. MAY be a Realm-scoped pairwise DID.

subject_id.description: Principal DID or disclosed holder DID represented by actor_id for display purposes. Authorization and audit continue to use the Event actor and member state.

payload_digest.description: sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON of this MemberIdentity object with the top-level proof field excluded. The signature MUST cover the same canonical bytes.
